title: Make infrastructure gate failures diagnosable and re-runnable on the same head
body:
Outcome: a required krn/gate failure that is infrastructure, not code, is distinguishable and re-runnable on the same head without operator Jenkins login. Evidence: PR #154 head 03425602 got krn/gate failure with summary 'Attempt d5206958-ad6c-47e0-9190-411dd281ecf3 failed or is unverified; base=unresolved/not-required; gate=true' (tests passed, verification failed); the identical-tree head a6c4134 then failed in 55 s with gate=false (attempt 74ca95db-699c-4e1f-835d-bda8f9bb3836). The check-run output carries no cause, failed-gate logs are not persisted, POST check-runs/<id>/rerequest returns 404, and a Jenkins rebuild needs an authenticated operator, so krn deliver exits 74 and the slice waits overnight. Triage: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/handoff-block/ci-triage.md. Owner: CI lead (see Controller.groovy:388).
Proof: the check-run summary names the failing stage and cause; a documented lead-runnable rerun (GitHub rerequest or krn ci command) re-attempts the same head; a regression test covers gate=true with an unresolved base.
